title: PodJob — control-plane→pod typed EventStream job
description: The payload of one typed EventStream job frame, dispatched on type. request is an InferRequest (infer_request.schema.json); spec is a RenderSpec (spec.schema.json); chain is an OpChain — a DAG of declared operations (op.schema.json + ops/*.json) run on ONE box with local-disk handoff between steps. Each carries its own version const (infer_version/spec_version/chain_version) — this envelope has none, contracts/VERSION stays the single pin for all three.

request.description: Present iff type=infer. Opaque here — validated against infer_request.schema.json.

spec.description: Present iff type=render. Opaque here — validated against spec.schema.json.

chain.description: Present iff type=ops. Opaque here — each step's params are validated against that op's own schema fragment in ops/<op>.json, read by BOTH sides. Deliberately not expanded inline: a per-op block here would be exactly the hand-mirrored surface the op registry exists to abolish.

session_id.description: Required pod-lane key (=tenant/session). One warm pod per session serves all its jobs; the pod echoes it on lifecycle events and terminals.

corr_id.description: Required per-request correlation id set by the worker at enqueue. The pod ECHOES it verbatim on every result/terminal, providing both result demux and replay dedupe without a positional fallback.

target_worker_id.description: Optional physical-worker fence for infrastructure warm-up; the API admits the envelope only on this worker.
